mapper.sql: SELECT r.campaign_id, r.request_uid, r.status, r.reject_reason, o.order_uid FROM purchase_request AS r LEFT JOIN purchase_order AS o ON o.id = r.order_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_request (request_uid, user_id, campaign_id, idempotency_key, status, accepted_at) SELECT #{requestUid}, #{userId}, c.id, #{idempotencyKey}, 'ACCEPTED', NOW(6) FROM campaign AS c WHERE c.id = #{campaignId} AND NOW(6) >= c.starts_at AND NOW(6) < c.ends_at
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign WHERE id = #{campaignId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_message (event_id, topic, msg_key, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, 'flashorder.order-commands', CAST(#{campaignId} AS CHAR), 'CREATE_ORDER', JSON_OBJECT('eventId', #{eventId}, 'requestId', #{requestId}, 'requestUid', #{requestUid}, 'campaignId', #{campaignId}), NOW(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_request SET status = 'ORDER_CREATED', order_id = #{orderId}, finished_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
UPDATE purchase_request SET status = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = #{reason}, finished_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
